_comment: 英文覆盖层：按索引对齐 foods/scenes/unis 的中文条目（本文件数组顺序必须与 zh 文件一致）。覆盖 desc/history 叙述字段；名称用各条目已有的 en 字段。
history: Zhengzhou was an early Shang capital — 3,600 years on the same site, the core of the earliest 'great Shang'. Shaolin kung fu went global from its calling card, the Shaolin Temple at Mt. Song; the Yellow River flows by its north side. It is the heart of China's railways where Beijing-Guangzhou and Lanzhou-Lianyungang lines cross. The Yellow Emperor's hometown ceremony draws Chinese worldwide each year.
importance: Capital of Henan · Ancient Shang capital · National central city
unis: Henan's flagship — the province's first 'double first-class' university, huge in scale.
An engineering-strong university; its water conservancy leads the nation.
The agricultural flagship of central China — wheat and maize science famous.
The province's top normal university — physics and Chinese both strong.
Information science and technology — the IT talent pool of Henan.
Light industry and food science — China's tobacco engineering cradle.
A young and dynamic engineering university of Zhengzhou's airport zone.
foods: Mutton soup with pulled noodles — the signature of central-plains wheaten food.
Fang Zhongshan pepper soup with pan-fried buns — the soul of Henan breakfast.
Century-old braised pork over cake — soft, glutinous, savory.
Iron-pot baked egg — crispy out, tender in, a Henan kung-fu dish.
Crispy-bottom soft cake — perfect with pepper soup.
Sweet-sour carp over stretched noodles — a Henan classic.
Xinmi five-spice beef in old-broth brine.
scenes: Ancestral court of Chan Buddhism and kung fu — the pagoda forest tells a thousand years.
The twin towers of the February 7 railway strike — Zhengzhou's landmark.
Giant statues of the Yellow and Yan Emperors at the river's middle-lower divide.
The Lotus Crane square pot and Jiahu bone flute — nine thousand years of China.
One of the four great academies — a 4,000-year general cypress.
The global Chinese worship site of the Yellow Emperor.
Only Henan — a drama kingdom in wheat fields.
A century-old commercial street — Zhengzhou's street fire.
